description_en: Queries the video sources of a production studio
kebab_example: aliyun live describe-caster-video-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --caster-id LIVEPRODUCER_POST-cn-0pp1czt0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCasterVideoResources

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the production studio.

If you create the production studio by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html operation, use the value of CasterId that is returned.

If you create the production studio in the LIVE console, go to the Cloud Production Studio page to view the ID. To go to the page, choose LIVE Console > Production Studio > Cloud Production Studio.

The name of the production studio in the list on the Cloud Production Studio page is the production studio ID
parameters.help_zh:
导播台ID。
如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html创建导播台，请查看CreateCaster接口调用返回的参数CasterId值。

如果您通过直播控制台创建导播台，请通过直播控制台 > 导播台 > 云导播台页面查看。

直播控制台云导播台页面导播台列表中的导播台名称即导播台ID
parameters.name: caster_id

BeginOffset.description_en:
The start offset of the video file. This parameter is valid only for video files. Unit: milliseconds.

Greater than 0: The read operation starts from a point in time that is relative to the first frame
BeginOffset.description_zh:
视频文件起始偏移值。仅对文件视频有效， 单位：毫秒。

大于0，表示从相对于首帧的偏差时间作为开始读取的位置

EndOffset.description_en:
The end offset of the video file. This parameter is valid only for video files. Unit: milliseconds.

Greater than 0: The read operation ends at a point in time that is relative to the first frame.

Less than 0: The read operation ends at a point in time that is relative to the last frame
EndOffset.description_zh:
视频文件结束偏移值。仅对文件视频有效，单位：毫秒。 
          
大于0：从相对于首帧的偏差时间为结束读取的位置。
小于0：从相对于最后一帧的偏差时间作为结束读取的位置。

ImageId.description_en: The ID of the image in the material library

LiveStreamUrl.description_en: The URL of the live stream

LocationId.description_en: The location of the video source

PtsCallbackInterval.description_en: The callback interval for video-on-demand files. If this parameter is set to 0, no callbacks are sent
PtsCallbackInterval.description_zh: 点播文件的回调间隔，等于0时为不回调

RepeatNum.description_en:
This parameter is valid only for video files. It specifies the number of times the video is replayed after the playback is complete.

0 (default): The video is not replayed.

-1: The video is replayed in a loop
RepeatNum.description_zh:
仅对文件视频有效，表示播放完后继续重复播放的次数。 
          
0（默认值）：不重复播放。
-1：一直循环重复播放

VodUrl.description_en:
The URL of the video-on-demand file.

This parameter is used only when the resource is a video file that is not imported to the material library. The video file must be in the MP4, FLV, or TS format
VodUrl.description_zh:
点播文件地址。

当且仅当资源为文件视频，且视频文件未导入素材库时使用，仅限MP4、FLV、TS格式
